name: Threshold from 1 October 2020: five hundred crore rupees

attrs.quote: for the words ―one hundred crore rupees‖, the words ―five hundred crore rupees‖ shall be substituted
attrs.scope: registered persons whose aggregate turnover in any preceding financial year from 2017-18 onwards exceeds the threshold, for supplies to registered persons or for exports
attrs.note: Published 30 July 2020, before notification 13/2020 came into force on 1 October 2020, so e-invoicing began at five hundred crore rupees.
